_note: Storey-word alias rows for a drawn sheet's view title (prompts/DISC_WALK_DRAWN_INTEGRATION.md section 7.3). A row maps words in a title to a storey by its INDEX counted up from ground (0 = the lowest storey at or above zero elevation). Never guessed: a title that matches no row gives no set unless the caller names the storeys. Data row, so it can become a DB table.

discipline_rows.source: definition: mechanical, electrical and plumbing services, the umbrella code of the BIM Document register (erp/plugins/bim_document.mjs Discipline list)

_note_discipline: discipline_rows (prompts/DISC_WALK_DRAWN_INTEGRATION.md 12a): a BIM Document register discipline code -> the walk disciplines a sheet of that code can serve. A code with no row (ARC, STR, CIV) serves none: its sheets are not read, and the tool says so. Data, never code.
